Reworked and browser-tested (auto-capture on save; a flaky capture fails then succeeds on retry; a normal one captures cleanly). 

**On the plain app [http://maker:4001](http://maker:4001):**

👉 **1. Automatic capture:** save a normal link (e.g. `https://github.com`). Right after it saves, watch a **"⏳ Saving copy…"** badge appear and then become **"🗎 Saved copy"** on its own — no extra step from you. Open Edit to see it dated and captured "automatically," with View/Refresh.

👉 **2. Capture failure + retry:** save `https://flaky.example/report` (I've wired that to fail its first capture). The card shows a clear **"⚠ Copy failed — retry in Edit"** badge; your bookmark is still safely saved. Click that badge (or open Edit) and press **"Retry"** — this time it succeeds. (`https://nosnap.example` simulates one that keeps failing, if you want to see a persistent failure.)

👉 **3. PDF:** save `https://arxiv.org/sample.pdf` — the preserved copy is the **actual PDF**, and Edit shows "Preserved PDF."

👉 **4. Internet Archive (separate & optional):** open any bookmark's Edit and tick **"Also keep a copy in the Internet Archive."** It's per-bookmark and off by default, so ordinary saves never go there.

**At scale:** on **[http://maker:4001/?seed=1](http://maker:4001/?seed=1)** most cards show the "Saved copy" badge, and a few show the failed state so you can see how it reads in a big list.

Confirming the decisions:
- **Every new bookmark is preserved automatically**; failures are shown plainly and are retryable from Edit — you never have to remember to do it.
- **PDFs keep the real PDF**; other links keep a page copy.
- **The Internet Archive copy stays a separate, optional, per-bookmark choice.**
